text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum: Córdova and Jacobo's INE payouts were "immoral"</u>

Former INE president Lorenzo Córdova left with a severance of about 11 million pesos, and ex-executive secretary Edmundo Jacobo Molina with about 13 million. "It may be legal, but what the councilors gave themselves is also immoral: 11 and 13 million pesos for leaving the INE," Sheinbaum said. They "earned 2 million pesos a month gross, and then they take 11 million." She asked the ASF and the FGR to look into the supplier monopoly behind electoral materials, which no administration dismantled, and proposed that the state-owned Talleres Gráficos produce them.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>In Mexico, the richest 0.1% pollute as much as the poorest 40%</u>

A new Oxfam México report, released ahead of COP31, finds that about 128,000 people, the richest 0.1%, emit as much as roughly 50 million Mexicans in the bottom 40%. Mexico's ultra-rich average 267.9 tons of CO2 per person per year, more than their European peers (236.6) and the OECD's (256.05). Mexico's poorest 10% emit 0.5 tons. "The ultra-rich in Mexico are the ones who pollute the most," Oxfam researcher Ervin Félix López told Contralínea.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>The FGR opens 15 case files on 30 years of corruption inside the INE</u>

Mexico's Attorney General's Office is investigating an alleged web of complicity at the electoral institute stretching from October 1996 to October 2026, spread across 15 case files. The lines of inquiry include influence peddling, embezzlement, money laundering and organized crime, involving former presiding councilor Guadalupe Taddei and other ex-officials. Separately, the federal administrative court has opened two files on INE contracts worth more than 563 million pesos, which touch officials who now lead the new party Somos.

🇲🇽🎻 <u>Narco's confiscated motorcycles become a music conservatory in Tultepec</u>

Mexico's asset-recovery institute (Indep) auctioned 57 of the 62 luxury and vintage motorcycles the FGR seized from Ryan Wedding, the Canadian ex-Olympian snowboarder turned alleged cartel kingpin, raising about 70 million pesos. Roughly 40 million goes straight to building Tultepec's Conservatory of Music, keeping a promise Sheinbaum made at the town's music school in 2024. The plan calls for 24 practice rooms and 16 rehearsal rooms, with about 3,500 young students.
banner: TULTEPEC: NARCO BIKES FUND MUSIC SCHOOL

text: ‍NYT: Border Crossings Have Plummeted. Stephen Miller Isn't Satisfied. November 13, 2026 | 🟢 📰 The NYT reports that the new White House chief of staff calls Ambassador Ronald Johnson almost every day to complain about border crossings. Miller's target is now zero. 🇲🇽 The paper credits Mexico's cooperation, and Mexican officials get to answer on the record. Crossings were already at their lowest since 1970 in 2025. • "Mexico has cooperated to significantly slow the flow of migrants." • Mexican officials: zero crossings is "simply not possible"

‍BREITBART: Photos: Mexico Gives Police Escorts to Migrant Caravan Headed to U.S. Border November 12, 2026 | 🔴 📰 The headline presents police escorts as Mexico helping a caravan "Headed to U.S. Border." Further down, Breitbart admits earlier caravans "disbanded" in Mexico City, more than 1,000 km from the US border. 🔍 According to AP, Sheinbaum says Mexican authorities "accompany" caravans and tell the migrants they have little chance of getting into the US. The only source is Breitbart's own photos plus a US Embassy tweet. Not one migrant or Mexican official is quoted. • "something that was not happening when the caravan started" • "support from Mexico's government was not openly seen or noticed"

‍AP/ABC: Sheinbaum rebuts Trump, says no migrant caravans have reached US border since January 2025 November 12, 2026 | 🟢 📰 AP leads with Mexico's answer, not the threat. 🇲🇽 Sheinbaum said the Chiapas caravan of about 600 people mostly broke up after its members were told reaching the US would be "very difficult." Officials are talking with a separate Honduran group about going home. She ruled out using force. The story ends on the tariff talks Trump's threat lands on: the 10% duty on non-USMCA goods, 25% on trucks, 50% on steel and aluminum, and 17% on tomatoes. • "Not a single migrant caravan has reached the north" • authorities have "extensive experience" accompanying migrants
banner: Sheinbaum: No Caravan Reached US Border

text: ‍FOX NEWS: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Mexico if migrant caravans not stopped November 12, 2026 | 🔴 📰 Fox runs Trump's all-caps Truth Social post almost word for word: "INVASION," "MEXICO MUST STOP THEM, NOW," "no leniency." Then the story turns to Republican attorneys general and Texas's SB4 law. 🔍 Sheinbaum answered the same day that no caravan has reached the US border since January 2025. Fox doesn't include her reply or quote a single Mexican official. • "Huge CARAVANS are forming and beginning their illegal march through Mexico" • "an estimated 1,500 people mostly from Central America"

🇲🇽💵 <u>Mexico asks the IMF for less: credit line cut to $18 billion</u>

At Mexico's own request, the IMF renewed its Flexible Credit Line for another year and cut it from $24 billion to $18 billion, the seventh reduction of a precautionary line that once reached $88 billion, El Economista reports. Hacienda and Banxico's Exchange Commission: "the Mexican authorities decided to continue the strategy of gradual and orderly reduction." The IMF board noted strengthening economic activity and inflation "close to target," and while it pushed for a faster fiscal adjustment, it said that should come without compromising priority spending on social programs and infrastructure.
